sourceTitle: 10 states team up with Google on free AI training
originalTitle: 10 states team up with Google on free AI training
author: Lisa Gevelber

blocks.text: Today, seven in 10 managers believe an AI-trained workforce is critical to their organization’s success, yet they aren’t offering the practical training that would help. We want to make it easy for everyone to learn how to use technology effectively and responsibly when it’s convenient for them, wherever they live and work.
blocks.zh: 如今，十分之七的管理者认为，一支受过人工智能培训的劳动力队伍对其组织的成功至关重要，但他们并未提供真正有帮助的实用培训。我们希望让每个人都能在方便的时候、无论身处何地生活和工作，轻松学会如何有效且负责任地使用技术。
blocks.en: Today, seven in 10 managers believe an AI-trained workforce is critical to their organization’s success, yet they aren’t offering the practical training that would help. We want to make it easy for everyone to learn how to use technology effectively and responsibly when it’s convenient for them, wherever they live and work.

blocks.text: That’s what led Grow with Google to partner with states across the country to bring no-cost training directly to residents. We started in Oklahoma. Then, we partnered with Massachusetts, where nearly 40,000 residents signed up through the MassTech AI Hub within six months of launch.
blocks.zh: 正是这一点促使 Grow with Google 与全美各州合作，直接为居民提供免费培训。我们首先在俄克拉何马州启动。随后，我们与马萨诸塞州合作，在 MassTech AI Hub 上线后的六个月内，就有近 40,000 名居民报名参加。
blocks.en: That’s what led Grow with Google to partner with states across the country to bring no-cost training directly to residents. We started in Oklahoma. Then, we partnered with Massachusetts, where nearly 40,000 residents signed up through the MassTech AI Hub within six months of launch.

blocks.text: North Carolina is now our tenth state partner to offer our digital and AI training at no cost to residents through NC LIVE. It joins Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Georgia, Massachusetts, Missouri, Oklahoma, South Dakota and Virginia.
blocks.zh: 北卡罗来纳州现在是我们第十个通过 NC LIVE 向居民免费提供数字与人工智能培训的州合作伙伴。它加入了阿肯色州、康涅狄格州、特拉华州、佐治亚州、马萨诸塞州、密苏里州、俄克拉何马州、南达科他州和弗吉尼亚州的行列。
blocks.en: North Carolina is now our tenth state partner to offer our digital and AI training at no cost to residents through NC LIVE. It joins Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Georgia, Massachusetts, Missouri, Oklahoma, South Dakota and Virginia.

blocks.text: Meeting learners in the places they trust
blocks.zh: 在学习者信任的地方与他们见面
blocks.en: Meeting learners in the places they trust

blocks.text: While each partnership shapes the rollout to fit their communities, they share the common goal of making digital and AI training accessible to everyone.
blocks.zh: 尽管每项合作都会根据所在社区调整推广方式，但它们都有一个共同目标：让每个人都能获得数字和人工智能培训。
blocks.en: While each partnership shapes the rollout to fit their communities, they share the common goal of making digital and AI training accessible to everyone.

blocks.text: Partnering with public libraries: In Georgia, Oklahoma and North Carolina, statewide library systems are the front door. Residents can check out digital resources, and take foundational courses at no cost. In North Carolina, this builds on Google's broader AI work across the state. For example, Google is the founding partner for the first-of-its-kind Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Research at North Carolina Central University, an institute dedicated to researching ethical AI and expanding student pathways.
blocks.zh: 与公共图书馆合作：在佐治亚州、俄克拉何马州和北卡罗来纳州，全州图书馆系统是主要的入口。居民可以借阅数字资源，并免费学习基础课程。在北卡罗来纳州，这建立在谷歌全州更广泛的人工智能工作基础之上。例如，谷歌是北卡罗来纳中央大学首个同类人工智能与新兴研究研究所的创始合作伙伴，该研究所致力于研究合乎道德的人工智能并拓展学生发展路径。
blocks.en: Partnering with public libraries: In Georgia, Oklahoma and North Carolina, statewide library systems are the front door. Residents can check out digital resources, and take foundational courses at no cost. In North Carolina, this builds on Google's broader AI work across the state. For example, Google is the founding partner for the first-of-its-kind Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Research at North Carolina Central University, an institute dedicated to researching ethical AI and expanding student pathways.

blocks.text: Teaching students career skills: In Missouri, state education and workforce agencies partnered to offer digital training across K-12 systems, colleges, universities, and local Missouri job centers. In Connecticut, Charter Oak State College launched an Online AI Academy to bring practical AI skills to residents across the state. This expanded reach builds on our work with over 500 education institutions across all 50 states who are part of the Google AI for Education Accelerator, a no-cost program to help students, faculty and staff with AI and other job-ready skills.
blocks.zh: 教授学生职业技能：在密苏里州，州教育和劳动力机构合作，在 K-12 系统、学院、大学以及密苏里州当地的就业中心提供数字培训。在康涅狄格州，查特橡树州立学院推出了在线人工智能学院，为全州居民带来实用的人工智能技能。这一扩展覆盖建立在我们与全美 50 个州 500 多家教育机构合作的基础之上，这些机构都加入了 Google AI for Education Accelerator，这是一个免费项目，旨在帮助学生、教职员工掌握人工智能和其他就业就绪技能。
blocks.en: Teaching students career skills: In Missouri, state education and workforce agencies partnered to offer digital training across K-12 systems, colleges, universities, and local Missouri job centers. In Connecticut, Charter Oak State College launched an Online AI Academy to bring practical AI skills to residents across the state. This expanded reach builds on our work with over 500 education institutions across all 50 states who are part of the Google AI for Education Accelerator, a no-cost program to help students, faculty and staff with AI and other job-ready skills.

blocks.text: Driving local economic growth: States like Virginia, Delaware, and Arkansas are integrating AI coursework directly into state workforce programs, economic development councils, and job centers, making sure state workers, career seekers, and local businesses can put AI to work right away.
blocks.zh: 推动地方经济增长：弗吉尼亚州、特拉华州和阿肯色州等州正在将人工智能课程直接纳入州劳动力计划、经济发展委员会和就业中心，确保州政府工作人员、求职者和当地企业能够立即将人工智能投入使用。
blocks.en: Driving local economic growth: States like Virginia, Delaware, and Arkansas are integrating AI coursework directly into state workforce programs, economic development councils, and job centers, making sure state workers, career seekers, and local businesses can put AI to work right away.

blocks.zh: 通过实用技能建立信心

blocks.text: We hear from people across career fields that they want to know more about AI, but they tell us it can be intimidating to get started.
blocks.zh: 我们听到各行各业的人们说，他们想更多地了解人工智能，但他们也告诉我们，入门可能会令人生畏。
blocks.en: We hear from people across career fields that they want to know more about AI, but they tell us it can be intimidating to get started.

blocks.text: We created the Google AI Professional Certificate to help them succeed. Through this training course they learn how to use AI to create marketing materials, gain insights from their data, prepare presentations, build their own apps and much more. And they practice hands-on with real examples.
blocks.zh: 我们创建了 Google AI Professional Certificate，帮助他们取得成功。通过该培训课程，他们学习如何使用 AI 制作营销材料、从数据中获取洞察、准备演示文稿、构建自己的应用等。他们还会结合真实示例进行动手实践。
blocks.en: We created the Google AI Professional Certificate to help them succeed. Through this training course they learn how to use AI to create marketing materials, gain insights from their data, prepare presentations, build their own apps and much more. And they practice hands-on with real examples.

blocks.zh: 访问 grow.google/gov 了解更多信息。
